SELECT M.MEMBER_ID, M.UNIV_ID, U.UNIV_NAME, M.LOGIN_ID, M.MEMBER_NAME, M.PHONE_NUMBER, M.STATUS, M.CREATED_AT, M.LOGTIME_AT FROM MEMBER M JOIN UNIVERSITY U ON U.UNIV_ID = M.UNIV_ID
ORDER BY
M.MEMBER_NAME ASC, U.UNIV_NAME ASC, M.MEMBER_ID ASC
M.CREATED_AT DESC, M.MEMBER_ID DESC
U.UNIV_NAME ASC, M.MEMBER_NAME ASC, M.MEMBER_ID ASC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER M JOIN UNIVERSITY U ON U.UNIV_ID = M.UNIV_ID

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_COUNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN M.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ACTIVE_COUNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN M.STATUS = 'SUSPENDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SUSPENDED_COUNT FROM MEMBER M WHERE M.ROLE = 'ADM' AND M.UNIV_ID IS NOT NULL

SELECT M.MEMBER_ID, M.UNIV_ID, U.UNIV_NAME, M.LOGIN_ID, M.MEMBER_NAME, M.PHONE_NUMBER, M.STATUS, M.CREATED_AT, M.LOGTIME_AT FROM MEMBER M JOIN UNIVERSITY U ON U.UNIV_ID = M.UNIV_ID WHERE M.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND M.ROLE = 'ADM' AND M.UNIV_ID IS NOT NULL
